description:
FILED s473c (Opus, 2026-09-08) while wiring the `line-track` gate (#1240).

%p-module-cache-path (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp) builds the cache stem from

    sxhash( <abs source path> "|" *pcl-cache-generation* "|" "v2" )

and NOTHING ELSE.  PCL_OPT is not in it.  A module's transpiled `.lisp` is
therefore shared across optimization settings: transpile a program under the
default, then run the SAME program under `PCL_OPT=none` (or any `-name`), and
every `use`d module is loaded from the entry the OTHER setting produced.

REPRO (s473c, the shape that found it): Pl/t/die-location-01.t's module row
asserted that a die inside a `require`d module names the MODULE file.  It
failed -- the module's own location never reached the register -- because the
module had been transpiled by an earlier run with `line-track` OFF and the
cached `.lisp` was reused when the run had it ON.  The row now passes
PCL_CACHE_DIR=<fresh dir>, which is the workaround, not the fix.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND #1240: `PCL_OPT=none` is documented as "the general-form
compiler", and Pl/t/passes-01.t's contract is that the two emissions RUN
identically.  Any measurement or bisection that switches a Kind-A gate and
does not also clear the module cache is measuring a MIXTURE -- part of the
program compiled one way and its modules the other.  That includes every
`PCL_OPT=` A/B a session runs against a warm ~/.pcl-cache.

FIX (not done): put the effective PCL_OPT setting in the hash, the way
p-eval's cache-key already carries everything that decides the emission
(feature names, capture names).  The string must be the NORMALISED setting
(Pl::Passes' resolved on/off map), not the raw environment text, or
`PCL_OPT=none` and `PCL_OPT=none,` would key differently.  The runtime does
not currently know the setting -- it is read by the CHILD pl2cl -- so either
the runtime passes its own PCL_OPT through (it already inherits it) or pl2cl
reports the normalised setting back.
subject: the MODULE CACHE key does not include PCL_OPT, so a module transpiled under one optimization setting is silently reused under another
